description: Source code for the PlayerWorker class implementation, managing media playback operations such as initialization, seeking, writing samples, and error handling within a media player framework.

classes.name: PlayerWorker
classes.description: Manages media playback operations, including initialization, seeking, writing samples, error handling, and thread management within a media player.

classes.name: ThreadParam
classes.description: Helper struct to pass parameters to the thread entry point, including synchronization primitives and a reference to the PlayerWorker instance.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a PlayerWorker instance with specified codecs, handlers, and callbacks.

methods.name: UpdateMediaInfo
methods.description: Updates media information such as current time, dropped frames, and progress status.

methods.name: UpdatePlayerState
methods.description: Updates the player's current state and notifies via callback.

methods.name: UpdatePlayerError
methods.description: Handles error reporting, ensuring only the first error is reported.

methods.name: RunLoop
methods.description: Main loop executing media handling tasks until stopped.

methods.name: DoInit
methods.description: Initializes the handler and sets the player state to initialized.

methods.name: DoSeek
methods.description: Performs seek operation to a specified timestamp, updating state and decoder status.

methods.name: DoWriteSamples
methods.description: Writes input buffers to the media pipeline, managing pending buffers and scheduling pending writes.

methods.name: DoWritePendingSamples
methods.description: Processes pending audio and video buffers, writing them to the pipeline.

methods.name: DoWriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end-of-stream for a given media type.

methods.name: DoSetBounds
methods.description: Sets the display bounds for the media content.

methods.name: DoStop
methods.description: Stops media processing and tears down resources.

methods.name: UpdateDecoderState
methods.description: Updates the decoder's state via callback.
